Chapter 6148: Immortal’S Cauldron

Chapter 6148: Immortal’s Cauldron

“Enigma did a great job at keeping its forces a secret. I alone am not your match.” Transcendent glanced at Chu Zhu and then the woodcutter.

Having said that, his eyes became resplendent and suppressive.

“But, my dynasty certainly has ace cards up its sleeves.” He declared.

“Boom!” The area shook violently as if something had pierced through the ocean’s bottom.

This force was beyond the means of any emperor or desolate god. A black shadow appeared behind him, stretching infinitely like an infinite realm.

A cauldron could be seen deeper in this expanse. The mountains and rivers within only served to support this core.

As long as the cauldron was around, so were endless possibilities. This was the cauldron of an immortal. Even overlords seemed to pale in comparison.

“This cauldron…” The mighty Chu Zhu took a deep breath.

“Looks like the one in the legend.” The woodcutter was wary of this artifact.

“The defining treasure of Immortal Suppression, an item from an immortal.” Endlaw felt fear.

“Dingtian Cauldron from True Dragon Court.” The woodcutter said.

“That’s the one, your knowledge is impressive.” Transcendent said.

“One of the few immortal artifacts in this world.” Disaster murmured.

“Dingtian Cauldron, Inferno Axe, Heaven Suppression Gauntlet, Calamitous Edge… The cauldron is unstoppable in Sin.” Dragonform said softly.

These were the most powerful artifacts in Sin. The stone axe was in the possession of Supreme Black Ancestor.

The gauntlet was rumored to be with Visceraless Young Noble. Because of it, even overlords didn’t want to fight him despite his weaker cultivation. One of its exploits included the effortless killing of Dragonblood Ancestor.

Amusingly enough, Dingtian Cauldron was not refined by Dingtian. It came from an ancient dao lineage known as True Dragon but went missing for unknown reasons.

Dingtian came across the cauldron at a secretive location in the lineage before destroying it. After reaching his prime and slaying his enemies, he bestowed the cauldron to Immortal Suppression Dynasty.

This was the reason why the dynasty couldn’t be destroyed despite many primal ancestors being stronger than Immortal Suppressor.

“It is not too late to surrender, I will ensure your safety. This is the best choice.” Transcendent said.

“I appreciate it, but members of Enigma will never surrender without a fight.” Chu Zhu shook her head.

“Very well, excuse me for acting then due to your stubbornness.” Transcendent’s power flipped the ocean upward. He could destroy the region with a single thought.

Disaster and weaker emperors felt an immense weight pushing down on them and crushing their spine. Endlaw became frozen.

“A fight it is.” Chu Zhu stepped forward and released a refreshing aura. An image of an emerald bamboo manifested into reality. The thin and small bamboo had jade leaves, relieving everyone of the suppression.

“Your dao is wonderful, Fellow Daoist.” Transcendent couldn’t help but praise.

“You have yet to use your dao, mine is nothing to be proud of.” She responded.

“So be it, we will see which of us is superior today.” Transcendent became excited.

Both were on the limit path and initiated their domain, escaping the shackles of the current dimension’s dao and karma.

Meanwhile, Bloodscythe Emperor pointed his weapon at Minisun Emperor: “Fellow Daoist, shall we?”

“Of course.” Minisun accepted the challenge.

“Hahaha, we’ve been talking about a fight to the death, I think we can finally have our wish today.” Disaster and Dragonform came forward.

“The two of us against you.” The white-haired sword user challenged Yangrune Emperor.

“I have eagerly awaited this day as well.” Yangrune’s sun soared upward.

As for Endlaw, he looked feeble as if one gust of wind could sweep him off his feet. Nevertheless, he stared at Bloodsparrow Emperor and said: “Fellow Daoist, let’s fight.”

“As you wish.” Bloodsparrow stepped forward.
